pages.text: $(bold)Holy War Relic$() (comes with Pyrium, $(bold)no levels$(), general trait)$(br2)Effect: $(bold)one extra slot of every kind, plus one more ability slot$().$(br2)Tinkers 3.11 only has $(bold)upgrade / defense / ability$() slots, so in practice:$(li)upgrade $(bold)+1$()$(li)defense $(bold)+1$()$(li)ability $(bold)+2$()$(br2)It costs no slots itself (it comes from the material) and stacks with slotless upgrades.
